source.title: General Solution of the ADFGVX Cipher System
source.author: J. Rives Childs
source.inspection: The complete printed pages 163/164 and all five source crops were visually checked. Dashes remain erasures; the source transcript is not altered by any edition.

key.credit: Published period key of George Lasry and colleagues; data/keys.json preserves the complete attribution.

conditional_context.status: Propagation of the existing historically supported 6th Reserve Division inference. The base key is unchanged.
